screen_lobby.png:
A background picture for the two-player lobby screen of a cute cartoon game about cat ninjas climbing a haunted tower. The scene: the village gate at dusk, the moment before two friends set off together. A wooden village gate stands open on the left with a paper lantern hanging from its post, a second lantern on a pole on the right, and between them a dirt path runs away from the viewer toward a tall dark pagoda tower far away on the horizon, its top glowing faint violet against the evening sky. Two small travel packs and a coil of rope are set down waiting by the gatepost on the left; on the right, low village rooftops with warm lit windows and a wooden signpost. A few fireflies and falling leaves near the edges.

HARD LAYOUT RULE - a large panel of interface text and buttons sits over the middle of this picture, so the WHOLE CENTRE of the image must stay simple and almost empty: just the open path, plain ground and open sky there, no buildings, no lanterns, no signpost, no busy detail in the middle third of the picture. All the interesting scenery goes to the left edge, the right edge, the top edge and the bottom edge.

Cute cartoon storybook look, thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, not photorealistic. Overall tone dim, cool and low-contrast - deep blue evening with warm lantern accents - so that a light interface panel can sit on top of it and stay readable. No characters, no cats, no creatures, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border. Output 1920x1080 PNG, full bleed. Save the result as screen_lobby.png in the current directory and report the path.
